holiday_hours_window_chk.name: holiday_hours_window_chk
holiday_hours_window_chk.value: "holiday_hours"."is_closed" or ("holiday_hours"."open_time" is not null and "holiday_hours"."close_time" is not null)

coupons_value_chk.name: coupons_value_chk
coupons_value_chk.value:
("coupons"."type" = 'PERCENTAGE' and "coupons"."value_bp" between 1 and 10000)
          or ("coupons"."type" = 'FIXED_AMOUNT' and "coupons"."value_cents" > 0)
          or ("coupons"."type" = 'FREE_DELIVERY' and "coupons"."value_bp" is null and "coupons"."value_cents" is null)

coupons_window_chk.name: coupons_window_chk
coupons_window_chk.value: "coupons"."starts_at" is null or "coupons"."ends_at" is null or "coupons"."ends_at" > "coupons"."starts_at"
